description: Score how ready a local business is to be named when people ask AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI) for a recommendation in its category, and get a shareable Radveo report with the exact fixes to improve its odds. Scores readiness from the business's own site; it does not query an engine live. Honest answer-engine optimization: improves the odds of being cited, never guarantees a placement.

business_name.description: The business name, e.g. "Joe's Plumbing". Provide this OR a website.

location.description: City or region, e.g. "Seattle, WA". Optional but improves accuracy.

website.description: The business website URL, e.g. https://joesplumbing.com. Optional if business_name is given; improves accuracy.

name: check_ai_visibility

aiVisibilityScore.description: 0-100: the share of customer-style AI queries that named the business. Null when the probe didn't produce a measured score.

business.description: The business name or website that was checked.

competitorsNamed.description: Businesses surfaced instead of this one (deduped). Same list the public shareable report shows.

competitorsSource.description: 'ai' = an AI engine named them; 'places' = real local leaders from Google's local results (shown when the engines named none). Null when no competitors surfaced.

enginesChecked.description: The AI engine panel the probes consult: an indicative read of how AI assistants tend to answer, not a live probe of every public engine.

note.description: Honesty framing: an indicative, measured read of how AI assistants tend to answer, never a guarantee of placement.

ok.description: False when the check could not be completed (bad input, rate limit, or the audit engine timed out).

queriesChecked.description: The customer-style questions asked to the AI engines (empty when the probe didn't run).

reportUrl.description: Shareable, public report URL for this check.

seoGrade.description: Letter grade (A-D) for the readiness score, when measured.

seoScore.description: 0-100 on-page AI-visibility readiness score, when measured.

topFixes.description: The top fixes to improve the odds of being named (max 3 here; full list in the report).

verdict.description: Whether AI engines named this business when asked customer-style recommendation questions. 'named' = at least one query named it; 'absent' = confidently not named; 'unknown' = the engines could not give a confident read; 'not_checked' = the live AI-answer probe did not run for this call (the on-page audit still did).
